mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase corporate earnings risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI inflation and federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts signals weakening residential demand that precedes broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth falls below 0.5% in a 3-month window, it signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO growth is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production signals broad-based economic contraction that increases earnings risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a federal funds rate rise above 5.0% signals aggressive tightening that reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during high-inflation regime when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.
